videos.title: Saturn, the Moon & the Northern Cross in One Sky | Ambient Space Dub
videos.description:
One slow pan across the night sky on November 17, 2026: the first quarter Moon through the trees, the Northern Cross (Cygnus) setting in the west, and Saturn shining above Diphda in Cetus to the south.

Stars labeled: Deneb, Sadr, Aljanah, Albireo, Diphda. The bright one in the south is not a star at all. It's Saturn.

Filmed on iPhone by Seiler Asterces.
